title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #18

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic etiquettes: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic etiquettes: to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   C. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   C. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   C. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Milad un-Nabi? (1 mark)
   A. Say Milad un-Nabi has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Milad un-Nabi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Milad un-Nabi.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. C — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Milad un-Nabi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Surah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Iman; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Love; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
